left.raw_text: Are at least 18 years of age.
Demonstrate a positive cough stress test
Demonstrate impact of stress urinary incontinence on quality of life questionnaire.
Are able to comprehend and sign a written informed consent.
Understand and are willing to comply with the study requirements,
including agreeing to be available for the follow-up evaluations.
Are psychologically stable and suitable for interventions
Are ambulatory and able to use a toilet independently.
